description.en: Four pill cards slide into fire, sun rays, flowing air and petals, with staged ignition, lingering particles and a glossy floor reflection.
description.zh: 四张胶囊卡滑到中央，依次展开火焰、日冕、气流和花瓣，退场时留下余粒子与地面反射。

keywords: 元素 卡片 轮播 火焰 日冕 气流 花瓣 胶囊 弹簧 反射 粒子 elemental card carousel ember solar breeze bloom WebGL2 FBM reflection kaolti

useCases: 用火焰、日冕、气流和花瓣表达选中的主题卡
A spring carousel with four procedural elemental effects and floor reflection
discovery.caveat: 四套场与反射需要WebGL2；降级时保留原生卡和2D粒子。源码许可未核实，Inter字体保留OFL许可。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML adapted to an instance-scoped WebGL2/Canvas2D core with six native framework entries, existing licensed Inter subset, scoped pointer/keyboard/wheel input and GPU resource cleanup.
source.license: No separate source license was supplied or verified. The embedded Inter subset retains its SIL Open Font License notice.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Click a card, swipe horizontally or use Left, Right and keys 1–4. Horizontal wheel or Shift-wheel also switches elements.
instructions.zh: 点击卡片、横向滑动，或用左右方向键及数字 1–4 切换。也支持横向滚轮与 Shift 滚轮。
